title: CHOCOLATE MOLASSES KISSES
instructions: 1/3 a cup of glucose , ( pure corn syrup ),

Put all the ingredients, save the salt,  chocolate and flavoring, over the fire; let boil rapidly to 260&#176; F., or until brittle when tested in cold water. During the last of the cooking the candy must be stirred constantly. Pour onto an oiled platter or marble; pour the chocolate, melted over hot water, above the candy; as the candy cools on the edges, with a spatula or the fingers, turn the edges towards the center; continue this until the candy is cold enough to pull; pull over a hook until cold; add the flavoring, a little at a time, during the pulling, cut in short lengths and wrap in waxed paper.
